access_session_valid.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.access_session_valid(p_legal boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select not exists(select 1 from private.access_enforced_users where user_id=auth.uid()) or exists(
 select 1 from private.enterprise_sessions s cross join private.access_policy p
 left join private.enterprise_accounts a on a.id=s.account_id left join public.organizations o on o.id=s.organization_id
 where s.user_id=auth.uid() and s.session_id::text=auth.jwt()->>'session_id' and not s.revoked
 and s.last_activity>clock_timestamp()-make_interval(secs=>p.idle_seconds)
 and (s.account_id is null or(a.state='active' and a.generation=s.generation)) and (s.organization_id is null or (o.status='active' and a.state='active' and a.generation=s.generation
 and exists(select 1 from public.organization_members m where m.organization_id=o.id and m.user_id=s.user_id and m.status='active')
 and (not p_legal or private.legal_ready(o.id)))));
$function$

access_scope.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.access_scope(p_org uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select not exists(select 1 from private.access_enforced_users where user_id=auth.uid()) or exists(select 1 from private.enterprise_sessions where user_id=auth.uid() and session_id::text=auth.jwt()->>'session_id' and (organization_id=p_org or (organization_id is null and exists(select 1 from public.platform_roles where user_id=auth.uid() and active and(role='super_admin'or(private.legal_ready(p_org)and private.verification_ready(p_org)))))));$function$

company_initialize.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.company_initialize(p_org uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$declare org_ uuid;depth_ int; begin org_=p_org;depth_=private.permission_enter(org_,'settings.manage');perform private.v029_company_initialize(p_org);perform private.permission_leave(depth_);return;end;$function$

billing_catalog.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.billing_catalog(p_admin boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by x.position,x.name),'[]'::jsonb) from (
 select p.*,to_jsonb(v) version from public.billing_plans p join lateral(select * from public.billing_plan_versions where plan_id=p.id order by version desc limit 1)v on true
 where p_admin or (p.active and p.available))x;
$function$
